I am an old woman with no schooling, but I have farmed this land for many years and I know what works. I will use the government fertilizer coupon to buy NPK and urea for this plot, because without it the maize will not grow well; I will also plant the improved seed they give us since it yields better than our local maize. I cannot afford chemicals to spray on food crops, and the rains in Mulanje have always been enough, so I will not irrigate. My children and grandchildren will do most of the work, but I will hire a few young people from the village to help with weeding when the rains come and the weeds grow fast.
